svg.aria-label: Atlas — heroic Titan bearing the digital celestial sphere
svg.title: Atlas
svg.desc: Cinematic mark: heroic, sculpted Titan in asymmetric kneeling pose bearing a digital celestial sphere. Marble figure with anatomical definition (deltoids, pectorals, abdominals, quadriceps), classical Hellenistic proportions. Globe is a wireframe sphere with Solana-gradient grid, three orbital rings, and decentralized network nodes. Cosmic dark background with stars and rim lighting from above.
